# Sessionboard Clone

> Open-source conference program management for CFPs, speakers, review, scheduling, and
> communications.

Sessionboard Clone is an open-source conference program management app. It supports the program-side workflow from collecting CFP submissions through abstract review, speaker coordination, agenda scheduling, and event communications.

## Core Features

- Public CFP submission forms with conditional fields, category routing, close dates, and validation
- Abstract and session management with status-based review queues
- Evaluation plans, reviewer assignments, scoring, and decision workflows
- Speaker portals for profiles, bios, headshots, tasks, documents, and portal forms
- Agenda scheduling across rooms with conflict detection for rooms, speakers, and availability
- Templated speaker communications, submission confirmations, reminders, and calendar-invite previews
- Speaker tracking dashboard for confirmation status and outstanding onboarding work
- Repeatable seeded demo data, including scheduling conflicts

## Product Boundaries

- Covers conference program operations: submissions, abstracts, evaluation, agenda, speakers, and communications
- Does not include payments, marketing, CRM, or a full CMS
- Uses event-scoped records and role-based organizer, reviewer, and speaker access; it is not multi-tenant

## Data Backends

Feature code uses a backend adapter layer. The judged demo uses Convex for reliable seeded-demo uptime. Airtable is an optional, server-mediated backend: credentials stay server-side, Clerk identity is verified there, and event-admin access is explicitly allowlisted.

## Tech Stack

- React + TypeScript + Vite frontend
- Convex or Airtable through a swappable data adapter
- Clerk authentication
- Cloudflare Pages Functions for server-mediated Airtable operations
- Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components
